title: Dimensionality reduction in M2aia for mass spectrometry imaging data
author: Jonas Cordes
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bwybpfsn

steps.title: Configure Signal Processing and Load Data
steps.instruction: Define the signal processing strategies and load the MSI image file into M²aia.

substeps.instruction: Open the Data view and set the normalization strategy (e.g., TIC), smoothing strategy (e.g., Gaussian), and baseline correction strategy (e.g., Median).
Load at least one continuous profile *.imzML image file via File > Open File or Ctrl + O.
Ensure the corresponding *.ibd file is located in the same directory level.

steps.title: Perform Peak Picking
steps.instruction: Configure and execute peak picking on an overview spectrum.

substeps.instruction: Open the Peak Picking view (Window > Show View > Peak Picking).
Select an overview spectrum type from the drop-down menu (e.g., Mean).
Set peak picking parameters, for example: SNR to 2, enable monoisotopic peak harvesting, and set min correlation to 0.6.

steps.title: Execute PCA Dimensionality Reduction
steps.instruction: Select peaks of interest and run Principal Component Analysis (PCA).

substeps.instruction: Select the peaks of interest (red annotations).
Select the target dimensionality and start the PCA.
Access the resulting image in the Data Manager view; use the right-click menu of the 'PCA'-datanode and the Component slider to change the displayed projected image.

steps.title: Execute t-SNE Dimensionality Reduction
steps.instruction: Configure and run t-SNE using the PCA result as input.

substeps.instruction: Ensure a 'PCA' named datanode is available as a derived node of the MSI datanode.
Set t-SNE parameters, for example: iterations to 200, perplexity to 10, and shrink factor to 2.
Start the t-SNE calculation and track the status in the M²aia console window.
Note: To reduce calculation time for images with many pixels (>140k), increase the shrink factor to divide lateral dimensions.
